motion.entrance: rise: from opacity 0.35, translateY(32px), blur(5px); scroll-driven (animation-timeline: view()), staggered by data-reveal 1-3
motion.vine: clip-path inset reveal from the right, scroll-driven
motion.guitar: rise 1.8s ease-out-expo, damped pointer follow (k = 1 - e^(-3dt)), 0.6 rad/s sway of 0.025 rad
motion.reducedMotion: no travel; guitar renders settled and still; entrances disabled

focus: outline: 3px solid ballpoint-blue, offset 3px; seafoam on the pickguard field; night-ink on the ink field
selection: ballpoint-blue background with white text; seafoam on the pickguard field

assets.art: public/art/ (owner's drawings, telecaster photo, flores.png linework mask)
assets.projects: public/projects/ (screenshots of the owner's live sites)
assets.references: design/references/ (unedited photos of the room and drawings)
